notes.title: Explosive Moltov Update is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740118/39874e85e3cca8770471d475bea9e83c27209bf3.jpg[/img][h2]Patch Notes - Version 1.4[/h2]  

[h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Weapons:[/b]  
[olist]  
[*] Added [b]Pirate Musketoon[/b].  
[*] Introduced [b]Molotovs[/b] for explosive gameplay.  
[/olist]  
[*][b]World Additions:[/b]  
[olist]  
[*] Treasure chests are now scattered across the island. Use them to replenish ammo and craft Molotovs.  
[/olist]  
[*][b]Missions:[/b]  
[olist]  
[*] [b]Second Mission:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Renamed from [i]"Muggy and Buggy"[/i] to [i]"I Know Why the Rum Is Gone"[/i].  
[*] Added [b]dry tall grass[/b], which slows player movement but can be burned with Molotovs.  
[/list]  
[/olist]  
[/list]  
[h2][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Visual Adjustments:[/b]  
[olist]  
[*] Swamp color palette tweaked:  
[list]  
[*] Shadows are now less dark for better visibility.  
[*] Reduced bloom for a more balanced aesthetic.  
[/list]  
[/olist]  
[*][b]Performance Enhancements:[/b]  
[olist]  
[*] Grass has been improved in both visuals and performance.  
[*] New Level of Detail (LOD) optimizations on objects have improved FPS by ~30%.  
[*] Added adjustable resolution settings for better customization.  
[/olist]  
[*][b]Gameplay Clarity:[/b]  
[olist]  
[*] Tooltips added to checkpoints to clarify icons for [b]dangerous[/b] and [b]extremely dangerous[/b] creatures.  
[/olist]  
[/list]  
[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Molotovs require further optimization and may cause minor lag.  
[*] Undead pirate AI is in its early stages and will need future adjustments. This is just the beginning of their development.  
[*] Loading screens may take some time to load. This is an issue that I am currently working on resolving soon.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update/Hotfix 1.3
notes.content:
[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Skip Checkpoint Mechanic:[/b] Skip checkpoint now only appears every [b]5 deaths[/b] (previously appeared every time).  
[*][b]Sarcosuchus Fight Music:[/b] The Sarcosuchus (crocodile) area now features [b]different music[/b] depending on the stage of the fight.  
[*][b]Sarcosuchus Loading Improvements:[/b] Fixed an issue where the Sarcosuchus area would stutter upon first loading.  
[*][b]Spinosaurus Loading Screen:[/b] Corrected an issue where the Spinosaurus loading screen looped the same music cue.  
[*][b]New Skip Button:[/b] You can now skip the welcome message when you first boot the game by typing in "skip" (Will add an actual skip button soon)
[/list]  

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Crawler Enemy Animation:[/b] Fixed the Crawler enemy’s attack animation to no longer instantly damage the player.  
[*][b]Crawler Hitboxes:[/b] Corrected the hitboxes on Crawlers for better accuracy and fairness.  
[*][b]Spear Mechanics:[/b] Vastly improved the spear’s hitbox to reduce floating spears and improve usability.  
[/list]  

[h2]Spinosaurus Recoded and Reworked[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Geometry Adjustments:[/b] Improved Spinosaurus geometry to reduce player obstructions during encounters.  
[*][b]Fairer Attack Logic:[/b] Reworked Spinosaurus AI logic to make its attacks more fair and reduce "laser-like" targeting of players.  
[*][b]Clipping Improvements:[/b] Corrected Spinosaurus physics to minimize instances of clipping through walls.  
[*][b]Developer Note:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] After observing players' strategies, I noticed many attempted to outrun the Spinosaurus and optimize spear throws to pass the encounter. While the intended mechanic was to use the [b]waterfall as a line-of-sight barrier[/b], I’ve adjusted the gameplay to respect these alternate approaches.  
[*] Players can now [b]more easily outrun the Spinosaurus[/b] as a viable option, though the waterfall strategy remains intact for those who prefer it.  
[/list]  
[/list]  

[h2]Final Announcement[/h2]  
Thank you for playing the demo and providing feedback! This patch is likely the last hotfix before the [b]content update[/b] for the demo.  

The upcoming content update will include:  
[olist]  
[*] New game mechanics.  
[*] Unlocking the [b]"Muggy and Buggy" checkpoint[/b] at the start of the swamp level.  
[*] A [b]new set of weapons[/b], including a [b]cool explosive weapon[/b] (details to come!).  
[/olist]  

Stay tuned for more surprises, and I’ll leave you with this teaser image. See you on [b]Primal Island[/b]!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740118/39874e85e3cca8770471d475bea9e83c27209bf3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Minor Update/Hotfix 1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
-Added an extra checkpoint after Spinosaurus waterfall sequence.

-Sarcosuchus (crocodile)  area no longer spawns previous boss battles if you backtrack on accident.

-Adjusted Spinosaurus area geometry to make it more clear on where to go.

notes.title: Launch Update/Hotfix 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I want to thank you all for your first initial feedback for Pteranodon 2: Primal Island. Below I have what's been added to the game! 

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]

-Added checkpoints between islands for the Sarcosuchus (Crocodile) area
-You can now skip to the next checkpoint if you die multiple times (not including the Spinosaurus) 
-New gui added to show large dinosaur threat type (Can it be scared away or killed?) WIP
-Boss fights are now more fair and behave more naturally.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Invisible wall glitch near "my name isn't Dennis" has been fixed
-Spinosaurus area has been rebuilt (Spino doesnt walk through walls as much)
-Multiple geometry fixes have been added throughout the level.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
-Lowered health on Sarcosuchus (crocodile) area 
-Lowered the speed of the Sarcosuchus
-Blood no longer covers as much screen when player is badly hurt
-Player sprint duration slightly increased
-Styracosaurus sprint speed slightly reduced
-Styracosaurus health slightly reduced
-Spinosaurus speed slightly reduced
-Spinosaurus no longer needed to be a certain distance to roar. Now he roars when hit by a spear with a 2.75 cooldown - Player still needs to run away!
